text_block_list.text:
One day, an invitation arrived for Biko Pegasus,
so we came to the designated location.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Is this... an event space...?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Justice Biko!
Do you remember me?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ooh! The girl who exchanged a vow of victory with me!
So it was you who sent the invitation!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Justice Biko
kept her promise fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
"So, today, we want Biko—
to watch our hero show!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? So this gorgeous stage is for
putting on your show...!?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... We won the gold prize at the contest,
so someone reached out to our club!
Asking if we'd like to perform in front of an audience!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, watch closely!
The tale of the 'Hero of the Turf'
is about to begin~!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
My name is Biko Pegasus!
Running to become a hero of justice,
the stroooongest Umamusume around!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah!? Trainer, that's me!
That kid is acting as me!?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
My Trainer and I trained super hard together,
and I got crazy fast! I'm not gonna lose tomorrow's race!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
Leading the pack right now is Hishi Akebono!
Making an early move, she's pulling away from the rest!
Is Biko Pegasus blocked up front!?

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe~ I'll give it my all~!
I'll win and deliver a buono smile to everyone!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...Heheh. You guys are good!
But—the hero always arrives late!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Here goes! —Uooooooh!
Pegasus Mach Ststriiiike!!!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text: Biko Pegasus bursts out from mid-pack—she's fast! Unbelievably fast! Leaving the rest of the field in the dust, she crosses the finish line in first place!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: YAAAAAAAAAY!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey! Did you see that, Trainer?!
I crossed the finish line by a mile!
choice_data_list: Looking at it again, it's so cool!
Looking at it again, it's so cool, isn't it!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! I'm so happy!!
I really am cool after all!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I'm so glad I worked hard for this!
I'm gonna keep giving it my all!

The play continued after that,
and they acted out Biko Pegasus's path of victories—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: Because of my small build, running aggressively might be difficult, but—

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text: "Winning despite the odds is what makes it so cool. That's how one becomes a hero everyone looks up to!"

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
I'll keep running and giving courage
to everyone! So don't take your eyes
off me, alright?!

text_block_list.name: Boy A
text_block_list.text:
And so, Justice Biko continues to run across the turf...
aiming for the unseen peak—!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
How was it?
Was our hero show exciting?!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
It was sooo, sooo amazing!!!
Remembering the race got my blood pumping all over again!
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Heheh... I just really wanted to express
how I felt when Biko
gave me courage!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you stand tall without flinching against such an amazing opponent
warmed my heart!
It gave me the courage to fight, too...!!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
So, thank you!
My hero, Justice Biko!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
...Aah!! Keep on cheering for me, alright?
As a hero, I'll live up to everyone's expectations!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Go, go♪ Our hero♪
Justice Biko♪
choice_data_list: You're in such a good mood!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Because I was
super-duper-suuuuper happy!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The girl playing me said, "I was able to become a hero everyone looks up to!" That means—

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Doesn't that mean she really saw me that way!?
—I actually managed to become a hero to her!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: And then, right here felt so warm and cozy... Heheh!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight! Still plenty more where that came from!
Justice Biko, reactivated!

Having achieved her goal,
Biko Pegasus received a wonderful present.
